mapper.select:
SELECT A.CD as cd , A.KR_NM as krNm , A.EN_NM as enNm , A.DESCRIPTION as description , A.ISSUE_CNTRY_NM as issueCntryNm , B.PRICE as price , B.PRICE_DT as priceDt , B.MARKET_CAP as marketCap , A.USE_YN as useYn FROM TB_COIN_INFO A INNER JOIN TB_COIN_DETAIL B ON B.CD = A.CD WHERE 1=1 AND B.PRICE_DT = ( SELECT MAX(SUB.PRICE_DT) FROM TB_COIN_DETAIL SUB WHERE SUB.CD = A.CD )
AND A.KR_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{krNm}, '%')

SELECT A.CD as cd , A.PRICE_DT as priceDt , A.PRICE as price , A.OPENING_PRICE as openingPrice , A.HIGH_PRICE as highPrice , A.LOW_PRICE as lowPrice , A.VOLUME as volume , A.MARKET_CAP as marketCap , A.ETC as etc
FROM TB_COIN_DETAIL A WHERE 1=1 AND A.CD = #{cd} ORDER BY cd asc , price_dt DESC

SELECT A.CD as cd , A.PRICE_DT as priceDt , B.PRICE as price , B.OPENING_PRICE as openingPrice , B.HIGH_PRICE as highPrice , B.LOW_PRICE as lowPrice , B.VOLUME as volume , A.DAILY_RANGE as dailyRange
FROM TB_CHK_COIN A INNER JOIN TB_COIN_DETAIL B ON B.CD = A.CD AND B.PRICE_DT = A.PRICE_DT WHERE 1=1 AND A.PRICE_DT = #{priceDt} ORDER BY A.DAILY_RANGE DESC
